title: Finish direct sign-in as the portal authorization-code flow

costar.context: Direct sign-in called GET /api/discover and then opened a JMAP Basic session when the local document had no client id. The maintainer said fix it.
costar.objective: A local /login document with no client id registers a public client, redirects with PKCE, posts the password to /api/auth, exchanges the code, and keeps a Bearer session.
costar.style: One plan, then the adapter, the callback route, and the sign-in screen.
costar.response: Continue registers the client and returns to /login with the authorization query. The password completes the code flow. The portal session is Bearer.

concerns: Anonymous public registration is the schema default. A server with it turned off cannot mint a client id and the account step shows the unconfigured sentence.
The registered redirect URI is the loopback callback for this origin. A cached client id belongs to that exact URI.
The device and OAuth query password path stays. This slice does not call a set method and does not build the Astro site.
context: The portal always resolves a client id, stores PKCE under its OAuth prefix, and redirects to the authorization endpoint. This server's discovery document is relative /login with no client id and no client-metadata flag. POST /auth/register with token_endpoint_auth_method none issues a stateless swc1 client id for a loopback redirect.
current_state: The account step treated a local document without a client id as a password step that called openSession.
target_design: That document returns a register step. The adapter posts /auth/register, caches the client id, and redirects to /login with the code challenge. The existing password form posts /api/auth. /oauth/callback exchanges the code and openBearer stores the access token. authorization() sends Bearer when that token is present.
changes: Replace the local password shortcut with public client registration and the authorization redirect.
Exchange the code on /oauth/callback and store a Bearer session.
Keep the device and query-string password path.
boundaries: openSession stays available for other callers and is not the direct sign-in path.
Do not echo the account secret.
Do not call a set method.
Do not build the Astro site.
The catalog login component does not fetch.

verification.name: discover-registers-then-redirects
verification.proves: A local document with no client id asks for registration. After a client id it redirects to /login with the callback and S256. An external document without a client id stays unconfigured. The login route calls discover and does not call openSession. The catalog does not fetch.

verification.name: ui-types
verification.proves: The sign-in route, the callback, and the Bearer session typecheck together.
